name: Scenes
tagline: See more carefully. Understand how you see. Grow a quieter photographic voice.
mission: Scenes is a photography craft hub. Available now: Photo Coach (including Shoot Review) and Photo Library. Experimental: Hidden Landscapes. Future direction (preview only, not finished products): Living Scenes, Scene Builder, and Photographer Profile. Outdoor Journals and a Portfolio suite are not deployed on this surface.

experiences.title: Photo Coach
experiences.summary: Shoot review and practical coaching for the frames in front of you.
experiences.description: Upload a frame or a session and receive careful feedback — what is working, what could improve, and a next step. Sessions stay private in this browser.

experiences.title: Photo Library
experiences.summary: A private local catalog for photographs you import.
experiences.description: Import, search, and keep frames on this device — the shared home for Photo Coach and experimental tools.

experiences.title: Hidden Landscapes
experiences.summary: Explore surreal and invisible interpretations of nature through spectral concepts, false color, and alternative visual systems.
experiences.description: A local-first studio for creative landscape interpretations inspired by infrared and beyond-visible photography — clearly labeled as artistic simulations, not spectral captures.

experiences.title: Living Scenes
experiences.summary: Add subtle environmental motion and atmosphere to still photography.
experiences.description: A future direction where still photographs can hold quiet motion — fog, light, season — without leaving the frame. Preview page only; not a finished product.

experiences.title: Scene Builder
experiences.summary: Interactive photographic environments and stories from still frames.
experiences.description: Product preview for compose / atmosphere ideas. A legacy studio still exists for exploration; it is not the canonical Scenes hub.

experiences.title: Photographer Profile
experiences.summary: A private companion direction for how you see over time — not a social profile.
experiences.description: Product preview for a long-arc private companion. An early companion surface already grows beside Photo Coach when you choose to look.
